description: Get an imageId and presigned S3 uploadUrl for one product image. Upload the image bytes directly from the client to uploadUrl with the matching Content-Type. HTTP mode never reads client or server file paths. The uploadHandle is for the local stdio-only `upload_image` tool. See `gency://api-reference/images`.

extension.description: File extension (lowercase, no dot). Must match the PUT Content-Type.

name: get_upload_url
